# One command per line; pushing a change to this file runs them on Modal via GitHub Actions.
# run 17c: skirt stage 1b only, 16 more FASHN backs beside the reviewed front. Stage 1b QA 0.12.0; no threshold changed. No azure line.
# Why not the skirt end to end: none of run 17b's backs meets both by-eye criteria (phase0-written.md, "Run 17b").
#   fashn@49 (auto-pick): tier seam at row 590 like the front's 593 and nothing hanging, but a red gathered waistband,
#   not the front's and the shop photos' pale pink smocked band, and a hem much wider than the front's: mask width
#   165/168/183/186 px at rows 665/685/705/715 against 151/142/141/120 (+14 to +66 px, both sides flared out).
#   Azure 17b showed extra hem width in a still growing into side flaps and hem girth in stage 2.
#   fashn@50: the pale band and the seam (585), but a dark strip 16-18 px wide hangs below the hem between the feet,
#   inside the garment mask; stage 2 would grow it. fashn@46: a slit with the grey leg above the hem, seam 5 cm high.
#   fashn@43 and fashn@47: no band. 12 FASHN backs so far: 2 with the band, 3 with the seam, none with both and clean.
# Keeps: the front fashn@44 (8909a1c0...) and the back fashn@49 (ec73328e...), the clean back with the right seam,
#   as the scored reference and the fallback the founder may still accept with its red band and wider hem.
#   Both resolve after the archive: run 17b's stage1b/ moves into stage1b/history/ and find_kept finds both there.
#   Checked on a copy of the artifact with the 17a export (input hash 99ab3ce9...); the keeps reproduce both hashes.
#   17a's back fashn@44 cannot be pinned (not in the current stage1b/); it could be kept from history/,
#   but it fails torso cover (0.916 < 0.92).
# Cost estimate (H100 list price $3.95/h; not the invoice): 17b drew 8 backs in 66 GPU s with the load ($0.07-0.18);
#   16 draws about 100-130 GPU s, about $0.11-0.25. CPU prepare and finalize under a cent each.
# Order: every export (no GPU) runs before the first GPU command.
# The modal line ends in || echo ::warning:: so a failure is reported, not hidden. No --accept-failed-dress.
# Review before 17d: the pairs table and candidates/stills/ at 2-3x next to front fashn@44 and both shop photos.
#   Pin a back that passes, HAS the pale pink smocked waistband, has its tier seam at about 0.63 of the length
#   (front row 593 at 832 px), has nothing hanging below the hem and a hem width within about 15 px of the
#   front's over rows 665-705 (front 151/142/141 px). The front's own hem is uneven and partly sheer at the lower
#   left (as in the shop photo), so a level-hemmed back will differ there in side views. Then 17d end to end with --recompose-dress
#   --dress-pin front=fashn@44,back=fashn@<seed> --dress-expect <reviewed hashes>, about $1.6-1.7.
#   Stopping rule: if none of the 16 passes all three, the next step is not more seeds but a founder decision on
#   fashn@49 (red band AND wider hem; stage 2 may grow side flaps) or a change to the waistband conditioning
#   (exporter / prompt). If the founder accepts fashn@49 with both, 17d can pin it now:
#   --dress-pin front=fashn@44,back=fashn@49 --dress-expect front=8909a1c04e63c3f26a54818a,back=ec73328ec8bbf1a758affe73
pnpm build:packages
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike shop:bohohippychic -- --fetch-images
git diff --exit-code -- spikes/garment-engine/data/bohohippychic/images.json spikes/garment-engine/data/bohohippychic/products.json
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt --dress --dress-only --dress-draws "front=keep:fashn@44;back=keep:fashn@49,fashn@54-69" --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt: run 17c stage 1b (more backs) failed"
